statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail holds at 12 in the low band because the observed session has traded both range boundaries and rejected both: QQQ made a new session low and then a new session high, NQ is capped for a second time near 29,660, and VIX is decaying to daily lows. That is functioning mean reversion, not one-way extension.
recommendation: Conditional attention concentrates in the narrow 14:00-15:00 UTC window on Aug 28, when Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote coincides with the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, with Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC immediately before. That is the only hour of the next 24 where the mapped state leaves green, moving to WATCH at conditional Tail 20. A lesser checkpoint sits in the 19:00-20:00 UTC New York closing hour today, where month-end rebalancing and closing imbalances concentrate flow at conditional Tail 14. Outside those two windows the mapped state stays on the calm baseline that has governed since the overnight hours, and no forecast hour approaches the block threshold. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Both range boundaries traded and rejected: NQ 29,629 capped again at 29,660 while VIX decays to 14.50, Tail holds 12
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade at 29,629.25, up 339.75 points or 1.16% from the 29,289.50 prior settlement, roughly two hours into the U.S. cash session. The session range is 29,401.75-29,660.50 against an opening print of 29,499.50. The decisive observation since the prior assessment is that price has traded both boundaries and broken neither. At 14:31 UTC the opening auction was fading, with NQ near 29,534 and QQQ below its opening level; since then the market reclaimed that fade and pressed back to the top of the band, where the 29,660 area has now capped it on a second test. Cash confirms the two-way character precisely. QQQ trades at 717.61, up 0.88%, inside a 714.53-719.27 range: it printed a new session low beneath the 715.00 level noted an hour ago, reversed, and then printed a new session high. Both extremes traded and both were rejected. That is the signature of a range that is absorbing flow, and it is the direct opposite of the shallow-pullback, repeated-extension structure that Tail measures. The cash index reads the same way, with the Nasdaq-100 at 29,527.24, up 1.04%, inside a 29,366.42-29,568.10 range and roughly 40 points below its high. Volatility continues to decay through the move. VIX trades at 14.50, down 4.67%, in a 14.48-15.13 range and sitting on its daily low against a 15.21 prior close. An index advancing more than 1% while its volatility index makes new lows for a second consecutive hour is orderly price discovery, not a repricing event. Cross-asset confirmation remains absent, which is what keeps the dominant mode assessed as mixed rather than trend-up. The 10-year yield is near 4.664%, up about 2.5 basis points on the day, and the 2-year near 4.22%, a move too small to constitute a rates amplifier. WTI is effectively unchanged at $82.24 with Brent at $88.77, up 1.06%, on the familiar combination of Russian export disruption against improving Strait of Hormuz shipping prospects; that remains the managed-disruption regime of recent months rather than a new geopolitical discontinuity. Leadership is broad but internally split. The Nasdaq Composite is up 1.25%, the S&P 500 up 0.63% and the Dow up 0.41%, so the tape is tech-led rather than uniform. Nvidia trades up around 6-7.5% after fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.22 billion, Data Center revenue of $89.02 billion and third-quarter guidance near $108 billion, while Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet and Meta trade lower. Software supplies the second leg of leadership, with Salesforce up about 20.6%, Okta about 26% and CrowdStrike about 18.6% on record net new annual recurring revenue of $333 million. That composition broadens participation without producing index-level directional efficiency, because the largest weights are pulling against each other. Macro is settled for the day. Initial jobless claims for the week to Aug 22 printed 203,000 against a 208,000 consensus, continuing claims 1,778,000, and the advance goods trade deficit widened to $118.8 billion; none of it moved rates or volatility. The forward policy question is where Stress still lives. Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, at the same instant as the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment, with Chicago PMI fifteen minutes earlier. That cluster now falls inside the final hour of this forecast horizon, which is why it is the one hour mapped outside the low band.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours cover the Nvidia release and its full digestion. From 15:00 UTC on Aug 26 the regime was mixed and calm, with Tail decaying from 13 to 10 through the afternoon while Stress climbed from 56 to 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC release hour was the only non-green hour in the window, moving to WATCH at Tail 21 and Stress 66. Futures reopened at 22:00 UTC on the beat and raised outlook, and the assessment stepped down through 18 and 16 in event/whipsaw mode as the gap held without extending. Through the Asian and European hours the regime returned to mixed at Tail 10-11 with Stress easing to 45-47, the calmest stretch of the window. The 13:00 UTC hour lifted to Tail 14 and Stress 54 into the cash open, then eased to 12 and 51 at 14:00 UTC as the opening auction faded rather than extended. Three hours are unavailable because no assessment was published for them: 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 during the futures maintenance break, and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27. Every available hour except the release hour mapped to EA_ON.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one quiet U.S. afternoon and one genuine catalyst cluster at the far edge. With both range boundaries now tested and rejected, conditional Tail sits at 11-12 through the rest of today's cash session, lifting only to 14 in the 19:00-20:00 UTC closing hour for month-end rebalancing and closing imbalances. After the cash close the estimate steps down, with the 21:00 UTC maintenance break the structural low at 9, and holds the 10-11 overnight floor through the Asian hours in normal mode. From the 07:00 UTC European open the path drifts up through 12-13 as the keynote countdown compresses positioning, reaching 14 in the U.S. pre-market and 16 in the 13:00 UTC hour that carries the Friday cash open and Chicago PMI. The final 14:00 UTC slot is the only hour outside the low band, at conditional Tail 20 and event/whipsaw mode, for Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote alongside the preliminary payroll benchmark revision and final Michigan sentiment. Event weight is carried mainly by Stress, which climbs from 48 to 70 across the horizon, rather than by an asserted price path: nothing about the keynote's content can be known at the assessment cutoff.
